description: Change of use from A1 to restaurant and bar, erection of single storey rear extension, installation of extractor flue and new external staircase and walkway to rear elevation and installation of a new shop front to building.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed use of the premises for a restaurant and bar from 11am to 11pm daily, and proposed single storey rear extension and new shopfront and ventilation duct is considered to be acceptable in that it accords with national guidance in PPS 1, PPS 6 and PPG 13, and it accords with policies ENV-B 1.1 and S 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - 2.	The restaurant premises shall close, and all customers shall have left the premises, by 2300 hours every day

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - 5.	Prior to commencement of development of this consent, full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the restaurant, and flats and offices above, against the transmission of airborne and impact sound shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details so approved

Condition : 7 - 6.	Prior to commencement of development of this consent, a scheme for control of fumes and odours, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant for the restaurant shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 8 - 7.	Prior to commencement of development of this consent a scheme for the ventilation of the restaurant premises at an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - 8.	The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing refuse or waste and for the recycling of  materials, including details of the means and timing of collections for residential, office and restaurant uses, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  These matters shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 10 - 9.	No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - 10.	No construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  0800 and 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 12 - 11.	Separate access to the residential accommodation and offices on the upper floors of the premises shall be available to residents and office workers at all times.

Condition : 13 - 12.	The access doorway to the restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level

Condition : 14 - 13.	Details of lux levels, direction and screening of any floodlighting / security lighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the restaurant use hereby permitted commences.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 15 - 14.	No live music or recorded music shall be played in the restaurant/bar, other than soft background music
